mind_map.root_node: Fractions (Equal Sharing, Fractional Parts & Equivalent Scaling)

key_nodes: Equal Partitioning Requirement: Whole object or collection must be divided into identical equal parts
Numerator (Top Number): Counts the number of equal parts selected, shaded, or considered
Denominator (Bottom Number): Defines total number of equal parts into which whole is partitioned
Unit Fractions: Fractions with numerator 1 (e.g., 1/2, 1/3, 1/4, 1/8)
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Assuming larger denominator implies a larger fraction value (e.g., thinking 1/8 is larger than 1/4 because 8 > 4).
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Unit Fraction Size Rule: As denominator increases, the size of each individual fractional piece decreases.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Dividing rotis, parathas, pizzas, and land parcels into equal shares.

key_nodes: Contextual Reference Requirement: Fractional comparisons are only valid when derived from identical whole sizes
Whole Variation Impact: 1/2 of a large watermelon > 1/2 of a small lemon
Discrete Collections vs Continuous Wholes: Finding fraction of a discrete set (e.g., 1/4 of 24 apples = 6 apples)
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Comparing fractions derived from wholes of different sizes without adjusting for whole magnitude.
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Fraction of Collection = (Total Count / Denominator) x Numerator.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Comparing recipe shares, agricultural crop harvests, and classroom student attendance ratios.

key_nodes: Proper Fraction: Numerator < Denominator (Value strictly less than 1 whole, e.g., 3/5, 7/10)
Improper Fraction: Numerator >= Denominator (Value equal to or greater than 1 whole, e.g., 7/4, 5/5)
Mixed Number: Combination of a whole number and a proper fraction (e.g., 3 1/2 = 3 wholes + 1/2)
Conversion Rule: Mixed to Improper = (Whole x Denominator + Numerator) / Denominator
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Treating mixed numbers as separate un-multiplied integers rather than unified composite quantities.
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Improper Conversion: (Whole x Denominator + Numerator) / Denominator.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Measuring baking ingredients (e.g., 2 1/4 cups flour) and fabric lengths.

key_nodes: Fraction Strip Alignment: Visual kit matching equal lengths (e.g., two 1/8 strips match one 1/4 strip)
Grid Folding & Paper Tiling: Folding square sheets into halves, quarters, eighths, and sixteenths
Number Line Mapping: Plotting fractions between whole numbers 0, 1, 2, 3...
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Misaligning starting edges on fraction strips when comparing lengths visually.
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Visual Equivalence: Strips covering equal physical lengths represent equivalent numerical values.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Measuring tape sub-inch markings and architectural scale drafting.

key_nodes: Multiplicative Scaling: Multiply top and bottom by same non-zero integer (e.g., 2/3 = 4/6 = 6/9 = 8/12)
Simplification / Simplest Form: Divide numerator and denominator by Highest Common Factor (HCF)
Cross-Multiplication Test: a/b = c/d if and only if a x d = b x c
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Adding the same number to numerator and denominator thinking it creates an equivalent fraction (e.g., 1/2 != 2/3).
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Equivalence Scaling: (a x k) / (b x k) = a / b for any non-zero integer k.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Adjusting recipe serving sizes and scaling currency shares.

key_nodes: Like Fraction Addition: (a/c) + (b/c) = (a + b)/c (keep common denominator)
Like Fraction Subtraction: (a/c) - (b/c) = (a - b)/c
Complementary Wholes: Remaining fraction = 1 - (Consumed Fraction)
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Adding denominators together during fraction addition (e.g., 2/5 + 1/5 = 3/10 instead of 3/5).
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Like Denominator Addition Rule: Add numerators only; preserve denominator.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Calculating remaining cake portions, travel journey completion fractions, and daily work done.
